WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    cr.coreregistry,
    cr.scoredate,
    cr.tenureyrs,
    (cr.scoredate - (cr.tenureyrs || ' years')::interval) AS start_date,
    bt.chaninvdatablock,
    ca.produsescore,
    ca.chanusescore,
    bt.bankrelscore,
    ca.custservint
  FROM core_record cr
  JOIN employment_and_income ei ON ei.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
  JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ea.expemplref = ei.emplcoreref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON bt.bankexpref = ea.expemplref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON ca.histcompref = cc.compbankref
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    LEAST(COALESCE(produsescore,0),1) AS p,
    LEAST(COALESCE(chanusescore,0),1) AS c,
    LEAST(COALESCE(bankrelscore,0),1) AS b,
    LEAST(COALESCE(custservint,0)/10.0,1) AS s,
    (chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High') AND chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes' AS is_digital_native
  FROM base
),
ces AS (
  SELECT *,
    (0.4*p + 0.3*c + 0.2*b + 0.1*s) AS ces_score,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM start_date) AS q,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS y
  FROM scored
)
SELECT
  y AS cohort_year,
  q AS cohort_quarter,
  is_digital_native,
  COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
  ROUND(AVG(ces_score),4) AS engagement_score,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces_score>0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS pct_high_engagement
FROM ces
GROUP BY y, q, is_digital_native
ORDER BY y, q, is_digital_native;

    (cr.scoredate - (cr.tenureyrs || ' years')::interval) AS start_date,
    bt.chaninvdatablock, ca.produsescore, ca.chanusescore, bt.bankrelscore, ca.custservint
  FROM core_record cr

  JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ea.expemplref = ei.emplcoreref
  JOIN bank_and_transactions bt ON bt.bankexpref = ea.expemplref
  JOIN credit_and_compliance cc ON cc.compbankref = bt.bankexpref
  JOIN credit_accounts_and_history ca ON ca.histcompref = cc.compbankref
),
scored AS (
  SELECT *,
    LEAST(COALESCE(produsescore,0),1) AS p,
    LEAST(COALESCE(chanusescore,0),1) AS c,
    LEAST(COALESCE(bankrelscore,0),1) AS b,
    LEAST(COALESCE(custservint,0)/10.0,1) AS s,
    (chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High') AND chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes' AS is_digital_first
  FROM base
),
ces AS (
  SELECT *,
    (0.4*p + 0.3*c + 0.2*b + 0.1*s) AS ces_score,
    date_trunc('quarter', start_date) AS cohort_quarter
  FROM scored
)
SELECT
  cohort_quarter,
  is_digital_first,
  COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
  ROUND(AVG(ces_score),4) AS avg_ces,

  CASE WHEN is_digital_first
       THEN ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN ces_score>0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2)
       ELSE NULL END AS digital_first_high_engagement_rate
FROM ces
GROUP BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_first
ORDER BY cohort_quarter, is_digital_first;

parts.text: Now I have the TCR formula. The "suspicious chains" = Suspicious Transaction Pattern (TAS > 75, Crypto_B, escrow disabled/minimized, Complex routing). Let me build and test the query.

args.sql:
SELECT r.riskregistry,
  ((r.txchainlen*10)+(r.linkedtxcount*5)+(r.fraudprob*100)-(r.profilecomplete*0.5)-(r.idverifyscore*0.5)) AS transaction_chain_risk,
  t.txregistry, t.payamtusd
FROM riskanalysis r
JOIN transactions t ON r.txref=t.txregistry
JOIN markets m ON t.mktref=m.mktregistry
WHERE (t.payamtusd/1000.0)*(t.txfinishhrs/24.0)*(1+t.escrowhrs/100.0)*(1-m.esccomprate/100.0) > 75
  AND t.paymethod='Crypto_B'
  AND (t.escrowused='No' OR t.escrowhrs < 24)
  AND t.routecomplexity='Complex'
ORDER BY transaction_chain_risk DESC;
